01 / CINEYRAPRIVATE · PRE-LAUNCH BUILD

Your taste.
Your next story.

A personal film and television discovery system that separates durable Taste DNA from temporary Tonight Context, then combines TMDb candidates, hard constraints, deterministic matching and optional Gemini reasoning to return three recommendations.

  • React 19 + TypeScript + Supabase + PostgreSQL + Edge Functions
  • TMDb discovery/search with server-side credentials; Gemini remains disabled in current project records and requires paid-service opt-in
  • RLS ownership policies, server-controlled recommendation writes, atomic feedback/rating RPCs and a best-effort request quota
  • Watchlist, watched/rated history, Taste DNA, Ask Yra conversations, JSON account export and a password-confirmed deletion flow
  • Prior live discovery/recommendation/export checks recorded; account-cache isolation, two-account RLS tests, deletion QA and legal/browser/accessibility gates remain
View verified scope ↗
02 / NOURENTRAPRIVATE · BETA FOUNDATION

Nutrition journeys with
professional review built in.

A responsive nutrition and fitness platform with an eight-step client assessment, structured nutritionist records, meal and activity planning, daily engagement, progress tracking, and Supabase-backed ownership boundaries.

  • React + TypeScript + Vite + Supabase with an explicit fictional-demo boundary
  • RLS-oriented data model and database-guarded nutrition-plan approval
  • Safety-gated activity plans with adaptable sessions and client completion tracking
  • Demo nutritionist review, measurement trends, notes, plan editing and revision history; live professional workspace remains unavailable
  • Quality gate recorded: 9 unit + 26 demo browser tests; live RLS, assessment safety pipeline, sample dashboard replacement and launch reviews remain
View verified scope ↗
03 / SPENVERAPRIVATE · LOCAL BUDGETING MVP

Plan it.
Track it. Control it.

An offline personal budgeting app with monthly cycles, actual income and expenses, essentials, savings goals, debts and transparent spending insights. Native devices use SQLite; web uses localStorage.

  • Expo Router + React Native + TypeScript, with native and web storage adapters
  • Linked essential payments, savings contributions and debt repayments; expected income stays a plan, not a recorded transaction
  • Actual-data charts, forecast scenarios, cycle comparisons, financial calendar and stored closed-cycle reports
  • Opt-in native bill reminders and versioned local backup/restore; web reminders are disabled and backups are unencrypted
  • 28 domain tests reported passing; storage/restore integration, web closed-cycle parity and device acceptance remain before release
